title: Skyblock Multiplayer
description: A lightweight client-side modpack for playing SkyBlock with friends.
body:
# Skyblock Multiplayer

A lightweight Fabric modpack built for one thing: **playing SkyBlock with friends as quickly and easily as possible**.

No giant mod list, no complicated progression changes, and no unnecessary additions. Just a clean SkyBlock experience with a few quality-of-life improvements to make multiplayer smoother and performance better.

## Included Features

### SkyBlock Standard

The core SkyBlock experience. Start on a tiny island in the sky and expand your world from almost nothing.

### Essential Mod

Play with friends without needing to set up a dedicated server. Invite friends directly and jump into your SkyBlock world together.

### Sodium

Improves performance and boosts FPS, helping the game run smoother on most systems.

### Mod Menu

Provides an easy way to view and configure installed mods.

## Important

This is a **client-side modpack** and is **not intended to be installed on a dedicated server**. For multiplayer, use Essential Mod to host worlds directly with friends. If you're running a server, only the SkyBlock datapack is required.

## Notes

The remaining mods included in this pack are **support libraries and dependencies** required for the main features above. They do not add extra gameplay content.

## Goal

This modpack is designed for players who want a **simple, lightweight, and reliable SkyBlock experience with friends** without spending time configuring dozens of mods.

Have fun building your island and seeing how far you can progress from a single tree and a small patch of dirt!

## Support & Bug Reports

If you encounter any bugs or issues, please join our Discord server. There you can report problems, get help, and talk directly with the team so we can improve the modpack together.
